summary.text: M. Keith Hodges is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 68th District, which covers Essex County, part of Gloucester County, King and Queen County, King William County, Mathews County and Middlesex County, and has served since 2012.
Hodges sits on the House committees on Health and Human Services; Counties, Cities and Towns; and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: M. Keith Hodges was born in Richmond, Virginia, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Hodges's education as Medical College of Virginia, School of Pharmacy (B.S., 1989).
The profile gives Hodges's occupation as pharmacist.

Hodges's listed memberships and affiliations include Urbanna United Methodist Church; National Community Pharmacists Association; Virginia Pharmacists Association; Riverside Walter Reed Hospital (board of directors); EPIC Pharmacies (board of directors).
